section.name: Example I
section.p: Accessing the page enclosed inside a <frame> or <iframe> element can be done by calling HtmlPage.getFrames().
Suppose you have the following HTML page:
You can use the following code to retrieve the content of two.html:
section.source: final List<FrameWindow> window = page.getFrames(); final HtmlPage pageTwo = (HtmlPage) window.get(0).getEnclosedPage();
